metadata.title: NewPassword
metadata.description:
New Password Generator. Can be used to generate passwords for automation process. Or just to generate quick passwords for any needs. 
You can specify the password length and the number of passwords to generate or output it as secure string.

findings.title: Plain text is converted to a secure string
findings.description: File 'file-00002.psm1' uses ConvertTo-SecureString with plaintext. This will expose secure information. Encrypted standard strings should be used instead.

evidence.snippet: $passwords = $passwords | ForEach-Object { Write-Warning "Converting the Password $_ to secure string, this is the last time you will see it."; ConvertTo-SecureString -String $_ -AsPlainText -Force }

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$NumberofPasswords' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$Password' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.
